title: QoS panel per-direction queue-depth row overflows the 300-unit panel plate — the entire rev group draws off-panel with no clip
evidence: app/qos_panel.odin:36: `QOS_PANEL_W :: 300`. :395: `draw_text(app, depth_label, QOS_PANEL_X + 10, qd_y + 3, 14, p.ink_soft_text)`. :408-422: `qdx := QOS_PANEL_X + 10 + i32(rl.MeasureTextEx(app.view.font, cstring(raw_data(label_c)), 14, 1).x) + 8 / for dir in 0..<pp.PORT_DIR_COUNT { / draw_text(app, dirs[dir], qdx, qd_y + 3, 14, p.ink_soft_text) / qdx += 30 / ... qdx += 34 (per cell, x3) ... / qdx += 10 / }`
detail: Two direction groups consume 2×(30+3×34+10)=284 units after the ~140px label from x=22 — content runs to ≈450 vs the plate's right edge at X+W=312. The rev label and all three rev cells draw past the plate onto the map; no scissor clip exists (no BeginScissorMode in app/).
recommended_fix: Halve the pitch (dir label 20, cell 24-26) and shorten the label, or stack fwd/rev on two rows — keep the row within QOS_PANEL_W.

title: NOC queue row's fixed 46px label column can't hold R<router>><peer> once node ids reach two digits — label overlaps the E-lane column
evidence: app/render/noc_overlay.odin:780: `draw_mono_c(v, fmt.tprintf("R%d>%d", pr.router, pr.peer), px + 6, ty, NOC_SIZE_BODY, NOC_TXT_DIM)`. :783: `bx := px + 52 + i32(lane) * 104`. :344: `NOC_SIZE_BODY  :: 18 // body/counters`
detail: Node ids are unbounded monotonic (E11); "R12>29" is 7 mono glyphs at 18px (≈68-76px) into a 46px column (px+6..px+52), colliding with the E-lane letter. Two-digit ids are the normal mid-game state; the old "P%d" (3-4 glyphs) fit.
recommended_fix: Move the lane columns right (bx := px + 64 or 72), or compact the label (drop the peer to a dir arrow: R<router><dir>).
